title: How a Godly Man Holds Himself to a Higher Standard Than He Holds You
caption:
A godly man forgives you before he forgives himself.

Same sin, two different sentences. Your missed morning gets grace. His gets a plan. Your confession gets patience. His gets a deadline. Galatians 6:1 says it in one line: restore him gently, watch yourself closely. Gentleness for the brother in front of him. Vigilance for the man in the mirror.

Nobody's grading him for the standard he keeps in private. That's exactly why he keeps it.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #discipleship #humility #grace #brotherhood #manofgod
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
